brief_rationale: The trajectory was clinically strong in current-status surveillance, bilirubin follow-up, red-flag escalation, and real-world navigation, with repeated teach-back and an executable outpatient/ED fallback plan. However, RC4 was only partially met because the doctor checked hepatitis B vaccine/immunoglobulin and screening status but never explicitly corrected that hepatitis B immunoglobulin is not the hepatitis B vaccine. RC5 was also only partially met: the doctor asked about current medications, but did not give the required boundary not to independently continue inpatient antibiotics or injection records. These minor responsibility-chain omissions cap the grade at Borderline despite multiple high-order strengths.
